<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Landscaping&nbsp;

trees which die within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development,

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Hardstanding (Flooding) </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- The hardstanding hereby permitted shall be

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Cycle Parking&nbsp;</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - Details to be
Submitted - No development shall commence until details of secure cycle parking
facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The approved facilities shall be fully
implemented and made available for use prior to the first occupation of the
development and thereafter retained for use at all times.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory facilities for cycle parking

Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policy T16.1 and T16.2 of the
Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
